<!--
Use this for a fleshed-out proposal to ADD a notebook or substantially rework a
module. For a quick "it'd be nice to cover X" suggestion, the lighter "New topic
request" template is fine. This template mirrors the fields a new notebook must
eventually fill in (see CONTRIBUTING.md → "How to Add a New Notebook"), so a
strong proposal is already most of the design work.
-->
